text:
Maya (CS): Heads up — prepping mid-quarter QBR for Norra Health. They had a sudden embeddings spike last week and want an updated spend forecast + enablement ask list. Any quick numbers?
Samir (CS): Saw the spike in the telemetry, ~3.4M embedding tokens over 48h. Looks usage-heavy on search rerank.
Jorge (AM): They mentioned a pilot expansion if costs stabilize. Renewal in 10 weeks — we should flag runway risk if forecast > 2x current commit.
Ava (Solutions): Can we map which routes caused the spike? If it's rerank we can suggest batching + prefix cache.
Samir (CS): Quick breakdown I pulled:
```
- baseline: 12M tokens/month
- last 48h: +3.4M embeddings (one-off job + daily heavy queries)
- projection if repeated: 24M tokens/month
```
Maya (CS): Nice. Jorge — what's their committed tier?
Jorge (AM): Committed 15M tokens/month (lapsed flexibility). If they hit 24M we risk overage and a surprise bill.
Ava (Solutions): Recommend short prescriptive playbook to reduce unit ops: 1) add 100ms batch window for rerank 2) enable prefix KV cache for session IDs 3) move low-priority jobs to off-peak. I can draft the config snippets.
Samir (CS): I can run a 7-day forecast with current cadence and a SLO breach probability. Quick estimate: 65% chance they'll exceed commit in 30 days if usage continues.
Maya (CS): Can billing-bot run an alert for projected overage >10%? Also need a cleaned list of enablement asks for the QBR slide.
billing-bot: Projected overage alert created: rule_id `proj_over_1789_norra`, threshold 10% over commit, notify @Maya @Jorge.
Ava (Solutions): Draft enablement checklist: 1) cost playbook (batching + cache) 2) 1-hr enablement call with SRE + dev 3) sample config and rollout plan 4) rollback criteria and guardrails.
Maya (CS): Perfect. Samir — can you attach the 7-day forecast numbers and a recommended savings estimate if they adopt batching? (ballpark %).
Samir (CS): Will do. Ballpark savings: 28-35% token-equivalent reduction for rerank-heavy flows with batching+cache. I'll upload forecast by EOD.
Jorge (AM): I'll loop in the customer and propose a QBR agenda: kickoff, spend forecast, enablement plan, renewal checkpoint.
Maya (CS): Great. Action items: Samir = forecast + savings (EOD), Ava = config snippets + playbook draft (tomorrow AM), Jorge = schedule QBR and share agenda (today). I'll prepare the QBR slide skeleton.
Ava (Solutions): +1. I'll also include a sample canary config: `batch_ms:100, max_batch:64, cache_ttl:300s`.
Maya (CS): Thanks team — will ping if customer asks for any additional data. :thumbsup:
